name: suite2p ROI detection

params.name: Registered Binary Movie
params.description: Input registered suite2p binary movie [<data>.bin]

params.name: Parameters File
params.description: Input suite2p parameters file, as outputted by the registration tool [<ops_registration>.npy]

params.name: Optional Classifier File
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <classifier_path>] "Path to classifier file you want to use for cell classification." [.npy]

params.name: Tau
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <tau>] "The timescale of the sensor (in seconds), used for deconvolution kernel. The kernel is fixed to have this decay and is not fit to the data. We recommend: 0.7 for GCaMP6f; 1.0 for GCaMP6m; 1.25-1.5 for GCaMP6s." [float, >=0.001]

params.name: Sparse Mode
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <sparse_mode>] "Whether or not to use sparse_mode cell detection." [bool]

params.name: Spatial Scale
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <spatial_scale>] "What the optimal scale of the recording is in pixels. if set to 0, then the algorithm determines it automatically (recommend this on the first try). If it seems off, set it yourself to the following values: 1 (=6 pixels), 2 (=12 pixels), 3 (=24 pixels), or 4 (=48 pixels)." [int, [0 4]]

params.name: Connected
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <connected>] "Whether or not to require ROIs to be fully connected (set to 0 for dendrites/boutons)." [bool]

params.name: Threshold Scaling
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <threshold_scaling>] "This controls the threshold at which to detect ROIs (how much the ROIs have to stand out from the noise to be detected). if you set this higher, then fewer ROIs will be detected, and if you set it lower, more ROIs will be detected." [float]

params.name: Spatial HP Detect
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <spatial_hp_detect>] "Window for spatial high-pass filtering for neuropil subtracation before ROI detection takes place." [int, >0]

params.name: Max Overlap
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <max_overlap>] "We allow overlapping ROIs during cell detection. After detection, ROIs with more than ops['max_overlap'] fraction of their pixels overlapping with other ROIs will be discarded. Therefore, to throw out NO ROIs, set this to 1.0." [float, [0 1]]

params.name: High Pass
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <high_pass>] "Running mean subtraction across time with window of size 'high_pass'. Values of less than 10 are recommended for 1P data where there are often large full-field changes in brightness." [int, >0]

params.name: Smooth Masks
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <smooth_masks>] "Whether to smooth masks in final pass of cell detection. This is useful especially if you are in a high noise regime." [bool]

params.name: Max Iterations
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <max_iterations>] "How many iterations over which to extract cells - at most ops['max_iterations'], but usually stops before due to ops['threshold_scaling'] criterion." [int, >0]

params.name: Number of Binned Frames
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <nbinned>] "Maximum number of binned frames to use for ROI detection." [int, >0]

params.name: Denoise
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <denoise>] "Whether or not binned movie should be denoised before cell detection in sparse_mode. If True, make sure to set ops['sparse_mode'] is also set to True." [bool]

params.name: Anatomical Only
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <anatomical_only>] "If greater than 0, specifies what to use Cellpose on.  1: Will find masks on max projection image divided by mean image.  2: Will find masks on mean image  3: Will find masks on enhanced mean image  4: Will find masks on maximum projection image." [int, [0 4]]

params.name: Diameter
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <diameter>] "Diameter that will be used for cellpose. If set to zero, diameter is estimated." [int, >=0]

params.name: Cellprob Threshold
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <cellprob_threshold>] "Specifies threshold for cell detection that will be used by cellpose." [float]

params.name: Flow Threshold
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <flow_threshold>] "Specifies flow threshold that will be used for cellpose." [float]

params.name: Spatial HP CP
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <spatial_hp_cp>] "Window for spatial high-pass filtering of image to be used for cellpose." [int, >=0]

params.name: Pretrained Model
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <pretrained_model>] "Path to pretrained model or string for model type (can be user's model )." See cellpose docs for a list of available models, e.g., 'cyto', 'cyto2', 'cyto3', 'nuclei'. [str]

params.name: Preclassify
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <preclassify>] "Apply classifier before signal extraction with probability threshold of 'preclassify'. If this is set to 0.0, then all detected ROIs are kept and signals are computed." [float, >=0]

params.name: Channel 2 Threshold
params.description: [from suite2p docs for <chan2_thres>] "Threshold for calling an ROI "detected" on a second channel." [float, >=0]

params.name: FOV vmin Percentile
params.description: Minimum value for the colormap range, as percentile of the FOV fluorescence [float, [0 <FOV vmax Percentile>)]

params.name: FOV vmax Percentile
params.description: Maximum value for the colormap range, as percentile of the FOV fluorescence [float, (<FOV vmin Percentile> 100]]

params.name: FOV Colormap
params.description: Colormap for plotting the FOV [str]

params.name: Show Grid on FOV
params.description: Whether or not to show the grid on FOVs [bool]

params.name: FOV Ticks Step
params.description: Step for the x- and y-ticks [int, >0]

results.name: ROI Detection Output Parameters File
results.description: Parameters file outputted by the ROI detection tool

description: Tool to run suite2p ROI detection on a registered suite2p binary movie
